lines.text: Believers are told to keep walking in Christ, rooted, built up, established in the faith, and overflowing with thankfulness.
Believers are warned against empty deception and are made complete in Christ, head over every ruler and authority.
Believers were circumcised in Christ, putting off their old idols, with a circumcision not performed by human hands.
Buried with Christ in baptism, believers were raised through faith in God's power, and God forgave some trespasses.
God canceled the debt against us, nailing it to the cross, and disarmed the powers and authorities, triumphing over them.
